model.name: OrbitGuard LightGBM tiers (Task A per CDM, Task B forecast)

sensitivity_note: Model sensitivity: the smallest single-input change (miss distance x0.5..x2, or max_risk_estimate +-2 in log10) that moves the frozen Task A tier down/up. Not physics, not causal.
consequence_note: Display and prioritisation only, never a model input. Simplified NASA breakup model, isotropic dv, circular orbits, mass proxy from rcs/area, active satellites only; see ca_triage/consequence.py
debris_cloud_note: illustrative two-body spread of >=10 cm fragments, no drag/J2; offsets are [along-track phase rad, radial km, cross-track km], null = unbound fragment
